spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Toma a todas las cabezas del pueblo, y cuélgalos a Jehová enfrente del sol, y vuelva ardor de nariz de Jehová desde Israel.

findings.issue: Lemma H639 licenses the noun in the construct chain after חרון, but morph HTa marks an affirmation particle; 'nariz' adopts the noun and closes the particle reading.

notes: Imperatives, 3mp object, jussive, construct chain, and מן stay within the tokens.
